tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (471)༄༅/ /dpal ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi ba sku regs ma'i rgya gzhung dang 'khor lo gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs kyi khrid yig bzhugs so/ /
(471)༄༅/ /dpal ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi ba sku regs ma'i rgya gzhung dang 'khor lo gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs kyi khrid yig bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (471)༄༅// dpal ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi ba sku regs ma'i rgya gzhung dang 'khor lo gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs kyi khrid yig bzhugs so//

(472)༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta gu h+ya sa ma ya ma hā kṛṣ+ṇa sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i gsang ba dam tshig thugs su sgrub pa/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ nag po chen po gsang ba yi// sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas// chags pas dbang du sdud pa dang*// drag pos las la sbyar ba yi// gsang ba'i man ngag bstan 'di'o// sku gsung thugs dang phrin las dang*// yon tan sgrub pa 'di nyid de// srog dang srog ma yin pa dang*// dwangs ma dang ni snyigs ma la// thun mong khyad par shes par bya// gtor dang dril ba las kyi sngags// ye shes mgon po chen po yi// yab yum sbrel mar sgrub pa 'dis// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po srung*// las mgon gsum ni 'di yin te// tshe bdag sku dang 'chi bdag gsung*// srog bdag thugs te gsum yin no// las byed bdud dang rgyal po dang*/ ma mo gsum na shes par bya// gsang ba'i yum ni khros ma che// dpung sgrol nag mo chen mo yin// 'di yi gsang sngags skyed tshul dag /sbas pa drag mo (473)zhes bya yin// gsang rten tsit+ta'i yang snying 'di// lus la bcang ba bsten pa'i rdzas// dar nag bris sku srog snying bcas// lus dang grib ma bzhin du bsten// lha srin sde brgyad dbang du 'du// bsang dang gsol ba 'dir mi dgos// phyi nang gsang ba ma lus pa'i// sku gsung thugs ni 'di yin te// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las// 'di ni yod pa tsam gyis ni// 'bod cing bsnyen pa sgrub pa dang*// rnal 'byor phrin las 'di yis 'grub// ces pa 'di dpal phag mo grub pas sku rags kyi lte ba nas dar dmar po sum yug gcig gis dril nas phyung ba yin no/ ༈ /na mo gu ru/ dpal nag po chen po sgrub thabs sku rags ma'i khrid 'di ni/ chos skyong phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub skor thams cad kyi gsang sgrub kyi zab don thams cad bsdus pa yin/

de yang phyi tshul du sgrub pa// nang tshul du sgrub ba/ gsang ba'i tshul du sgrub pa dang gsum las/ dang po phyi sgrub ni/ gnas dben par sgrub pa'i cha rkyen 'dzom par bya zhing*/ mchod gtor gyi dngos po ci 'dzom maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du (474)bsham/ de nas rang nyid stan bde ba la bsam gtan yan lag gis gnas par byas la/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed bsdus pa byas/ skad cig gis thun mtshams kyi he ru kar gsal bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ zhu ba las sna tshogs rdo rje shar gyi rwa lnga dkar ba/ lho'i rwa lnga ser ba/ nub kyi rwa lnga dmar ba/ byang gi rwa lnga ljang ba/ lte ba mthing ga yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag /hūm̐ de las rdo rje dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad du song bas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba/ bla bre bskal pa'i rlung gis bskyod par mi nus shing*/ sra ba mkhreg pa'i gur du gyur/ hūm̐ las rdo rje phra mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ sngar gyi gur khang de'i gseng thams cad bton nas zhal byas pas rlung ser bu yang mi thar bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'og gi nyi ma las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur khang gi phyi rol du ye shes kyi me ri kha dog lnga'i rang bzhin du 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ raṃ/ de ni 'di'i lugs kyi srung 'khor ro// de'i nang du rang nyid he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor lo bde mchog la bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mchod pa 'bul bdun rnam dag bya// de rnams 'od du zhu nas bdag dang gnyis su med par bsam/ de rjes sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/

sdug bsngal dang bral nas myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srog bzhin du bsrung*/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid (475)bsgom par bgyi'o// tshad med pa bzhi la sogs rgyud la ma skyes kyi bar sher snying tshar gsum bton pa'i yun tsam du nan tan byas la bsgom/ rgyud la lhang gis skyes pa'i rtags su/ sems can thams cad la snying rje rang shugs kyis skyes pa'am/ rang gi sems rgyud mnyen lhan gyis 'gro ba'am/ lus kyi mtshan khung rdul chil 'ong*/ de lta bu byung ba dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sogs/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur par bsam/ des ni dwangs ma'i srog phyag rgya chen po la gnad du bsnun pa'o// dwangs ma'i srog 'di med na nag po chen po gtan nas mi 'grub gsungs/ de'i rjes nas rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin bsgom// sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ go cha dgod/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang blang*/ dbang bskur dbu brgyan pa yan byed/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir bzlas pa phreng skor gcig bya/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du ye nas gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi tha mar yi ge bdun pa dang*/ phyag bzhi pa'i yi ge bdun nam/ bcu gsum pa'am gang rung gis bskor bar bsgom/ de nas mdun bskyed du/ rten gtor ma/ yang na me tog tshom bu'am/ med kyang ting nge 'dzin gyis bya ste/ gdan pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du baṃ bsnol ba'i steng du bdag he ru ka'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ las sras kyi tshul du hūm̐ gcig spros pa mdun gyi gdan la 'dug par bsam la// de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ gdug pa can tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje gri gug tu gyur/ 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas nas yongs su gyur pa las/

dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ dbu rgyan yan byas/ (476)de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ nag po'i mthar yi ge bdun pa'am/ yi ge bcu pas bskor bar bsgom/ de nas rang gis sngags bzlas pas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi ye shes mgon po'i thugs kar thim/ zhal nas rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar thim par bsgom/ sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran nas phrin las bzhi la sogs pa gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub ster bar bsam/ 'phro 'du'i bzlas pa bya'o// mthar sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dang*/ mthu dang nus pa/ tshe dang dpal dang grags pa mi nor zas gsum gyi dngos grub thams cad mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs kyi tshul du rang gi thugs kar 'ub kyis 'dus par bsam mo/ de nas gtor ma 'bul/ bstod pa bya/ mdun gyi lha rang ngam rten la bstims la yi ge brgya pa brjod/ rjes la dwangs ma'i srog phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag /thun mgo mjug la dwangs ma'i srog la gnad du bsnun pa ni/ ye shes mgon po sgrub pa'i gnad zab mo yin no// de ni phyi ltar sgrub pa'o// da ni nang ltar sgrub pa'i man ngag ni/ gong gi skyabs 'gro nas srung 'khor bsgom pa/ he ru ka'i mngon rtogs nas bsnyen pa phreng skor gcig yan gyis brtan par bya ba gong dang 'dra'o// gong bzhin du rang nyid kyi thugs ka nas hūm̐ gcig sras kyi tshul du 'phro ba la sogs mdun du mgon po yab yum zhal sbyor du bsgom pa dang*/ 'khor las bzhi/ seng gdong tsan+ti ka la sogs 'og gi gsang sgrub kyi nang ltar bsgom/ nag po stong la sogs sde brgyad dang sbrel nas bsgom pa la sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med/ dbang bskur dbu brgyan pa yan bya/ bsnyen pa/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pa ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa bco lnga pa las 'od zer (477)gong lta bu'i 'phro 'du'i dmigs pa bya/

bzlas pa bya/ thun mgo mjug la dwangs ma'i srog phyag rgya chen po la gnad du bsnun pa gong ltar bya'o// gtor ma bstod ba bya/ mdun bskyed rang la bstim/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ de ni nang ltar sgrub pa'o// sku gsum las de gnyis ni sprul skur sgrub pa'o// da ni gsang ba'i sgrub pa ston te/ 'di la gnyis lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ gsang gnas la brten nas longs spyod rdzogs sku'i tshul du sgrub pa dang*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la brten nas chos skur sgrub pa'o// dang po lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor la brten nas longs skur sgrub pa ni/ dang po skyabs 'gro dang*/ srung 'khor dang*/ bde mchog lhan skyes bsgom pa gong ltar byas la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyi brlabs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur dbu brgyan/ bsnyen pa phreng skor gcig tsam gyis gsal zhing brtan par byas/ da ni ye nas gnas tshul lam du byed pa ni/ gsang ba'i khrid kyi dmigs pa la/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum gyi sku'i nang khong stong shel gyi bum pa'i nang lta bu phyi gsal nang gsal ma bsgribs pa'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po sbom phra mda' smyug tsam khog pa stong pa/ yar sne spyi gtsug /mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa/ g.yas su rtsa ro ma dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po/ de gnyis yar sne spyi gtsug nas sna bug gnyis su zug par bsgom/ mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi pa gnang gnas su rtsa gnyis kyi sne dbu ma'i nang du 'dus par bsam/ gsang gnas rtsa gsum 'dus mdo nas/ gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis yod pa/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo dbus su oṃ yod pa rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo dbus na hūm̐ yod/ rtsa 'dab ma brgyad (478)yod pa/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo na dbus su oṃ yod/

rtsa 'dab ma bcu drug yod pa/ spyi gtsug bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i dbus na ham̐ yod/ rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis yod pa'o// de ni ye nas gnas lugs so// de rnams gsal btab la rlung la gnad du bsnun pas yun bsrings la bsgom/ stong ra de la dmigs pa gsal zhing brtan pa gal che'o// de nas gsang gnas su rtsa gsum 'dus mdo na rang byung gi chos 'byung gru gsum yod la/ de'i dbus su ye gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis lhun grub tu rang byung gis gnas pa'i srog yum gyi sa bon bam̐ mam hrīḥ'am/ a thung shad kyi rnam pa'am/ gtum mo zhes gsungs pa yod pa'o// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du gnas pa'i srog a'am hūm̐ ser po las/ yon tan gyi mgon po 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas rdo rje rin po che dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam rlon dang rus pa'i rgyan cha drug dang*/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis gar thabs kyis bzhengs nas 'jigs phyed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog ser mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ thod pa skam po dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i dbus su zla ba'i gdan steng du gnas pa'i ye nas gnas tshul lam du byed pa srog hūm̐ sngon po bsgom/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas mar 'phros/ lte ba'i lhan skyes kyi lha tshogs kyi thugs kar phyog /thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas rtsa gsum 'dus mdo nas yar song*/ yang 'od zer de rtsa g.yas pa ro ma'i nang nas yar byon nas sna bug g.yas nas byung*/ rlung gcig 'bud pa dang bsdongs nas 'od zer de rje btsun mar gyur nas/ rje (479)btsun ma dang sna bug g.yas pa'i rlung bsdongs nas 'od 'phros pas/

'og min gyi gnas/ rgya gar rdo rje'i gdan/ dur khrod brgyad dang bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i chos skyong pho rgyud rnams la phog /de rnams 'od zer du gyur/ 'dar zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes kyi mgon po gcig tu gyur/ de'i thugs kar gnas pa'i srog hūm̐ gcig bsam/ de nas 'od zer rje btsun mar gyur pa'i phyag g.yas pa'i gri gug gis gnas pa'i srog hūm̐ de la 'jus nas/ sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs la myur du byon cig /ma byon na gri gug gis gnas pa'i srog gcod do// zhes pa'i tshul du bskul nas/ rlung 'tshubs kyis sbur ma bsdus pa ltar rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas rlung gcig rngubs pa dang lhan du rang gi sna bug g.yas su zhugs/ rtsa g.yas pa la thim par bsam/ de yang phyi'i rten 'brel du nag po stong*/ nang gi rten 'brel du rtsa g.yas pa la rtsa sna stong gis bskor nas yod pa'o// gsang ba'i rten 'brel du rtsa la gnad du bsnun pa'i phyi'i nag po stong dbang du 'dus nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srog bzhin tu srung*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i dus su zhe sdang srid pa po rgyud pa'i srog zhe sdang yin/ de'i rtags byis pa chung ngu la yang zhe sdang gi gtam dang rnam 'gyur bstan na rngam rngam tsig tsig la 'gro ba de yin no gsungs/ mchan yin/ rtogs pa'i dus su gsal stong zung 'jug yin/ 'bras bu'i dus su sprul sku mngon du gyur/ rtsa rlung thig le yang las mgon/ las mgon yang rtsa rlung thig le yin/ de la gnad du bsnun pa bsgom mo/ rang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer mar 'phros/ lte ba'i lhan skyes la phog /thugs dam rgyud bskul lhan skyes kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer mar byon nas rtsa gsum 'dus mdo nas g.yon rtsa rkyang ma'i nang nas yar byung*/ sna bug g.yon nas rlung phyir song (480)ba dang bsdongs nas phyir 'phros pa dang 'od zer rje btsun mar gyur pa dang*/

rang gis sbud pa'i rlung gnyis bsdongs nas/ 'og min rgya gar rdo rje gdan dur khrod brgyad dang bsil ba'i tshal nas chos skyong mo rgyud rnams la phog /de rnams 'od zer du gyur pas 'dar zhing yongs su gyur nas yum rtsa 'jib ma gcig tu gyur/ de'i thugs kar gnas pa'i srog bh+yoḥyig bsgom/ de nas 'od zer rje btsun mar gyur pa gong ltar bsgoms nas rlung gcig rngubs pa dang lhan du/ rang gi sna bug g.yon du zhugs rtsa g.yon pa la thim par bsam/ phyi'i rten 'brel lam mo bye ba/ nang gi rten 'brel la rtsa g.yon pa la rtsa sna bye bas bskor nas yod/ gsang rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas/ 'od zer rje btsun mar gyur pa de dang dpal lha mo dang gnas srog bh+yoḥdang rang gi rlung dang bzhi'o/ mchan/ ba'i rten 'brel la rtsa rlung sems la gnad du bsnun pas/ ma mo bye ba dbang du 'dus nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srog bzhin du gyur/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i dus su 'dod chags de'i rtags su 'jig rten las chags pa'i gtam brjod pa'i tshe bu mo chung ngu yin yang se'u tsag tsag la 'gro bar gda' gsungs/ mchan/ rtogs na bde stong zung 'jug grub pa'i dus longs sku yin/ rtsa rlung thig le yang ma mo yin/ ma mo yang rtsa rlung thig le yin/ rlung bzung la bsgom pa'o// yang phyi'i rten 'brel du ye shes/

srid pa mo rgyud kyi srog 'dod chags yin/ /mgon po/ nang gi rten 'brel du rtsa dbu ma/ gsang pa'i rten 'brel du rtsa rlung thig le la/ gtum mo lta bur gnad du bsnun pas/ ye shes mgon po dbang du 'dus nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srog bzhin du srung*/ de ltar ma rtogs na gti mug srid pa pho rgyud kyi srog /rtogs na rig stong zung 'jug gi ye shes/ 'bras bu chos sku/ rtsa rlung thig le yang ye shes kyi mgon po/ ye (481)shes mgon po yang rtsa rlung thig le yin no// rlung steng 'og kha sbyor la sems kyi gnad sher nyer yun ring du bsnun/ rtsa g.yas kyi nag po stong ye shes mgon por gyur/ rtsa g.yas pa'i nang du zhugs par bsgom// g.yon gyi ma mo bye ba yum tsan+ti kar gyur/ rtsa g.yon pa'i nang du zhugs par bsgom/ dper na 'jig rten pa'i pho gzhon mo gzhon gnyis gcig la gcig chags nas dus 'debs pa bzhin/ yab yum gnyis gcig la gcig chags pa'i tshul gyis phar gzigs tshur gzigs mdzad pas/ de ni chags pas dbang du bsdu ba ste/ phyi nang gsang gsum la 'dir rje btsun mar bsgoms bas/ pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams phyi rol nas bsdus te/ phyi ltar chags pas dbang du sdud pa yin/ nang gi rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis nas yab yum gnyis phar gzigs tshur gzigs mdzad nas gsang gnas su rtsa gsum 'dus mdor byon pa de ni nang ltar chags pas dbang du bsdu ba'o// nang gi 'khor lo gnyis su snyoms 'jug byed pa la sems gnad du bsnun pa zhabs nas 'ong ba ni gsang ba ltar chags pas dbang du sdud pa'o// yab yum gnyis rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mar byon/ gsang gnas rtsa gsum 'dus mdo'i rang byung gi chos 'byung yod pa de'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma zur gsum chos 'byung gi nang khengs pa ro'i gdan gan rkyal du bsnol ba'i steng du/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/

phyag g.yas dang po bhe ta'i 'bras bu dmar po rlon pa dang*/ g.yon gyi dang pos ma mo 'i dbus su/ mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du ba/ thod khrag bsnams nas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi 'og mas dgra bgegs thams cad rtsad nas gcod pa/ dngos grub longs spyod char ltar 'bebs/ (482)ral gri dang*/ g.yon gyi 'og mas kha ṭ+wāṃ phyar pa/ zhal gdangs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum zlum pa/ spyan rtsa dmar ba/ ag tshom dang sma ra dmar ser dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ sku stod glang chen gzhan la 'di med ko rlon dang*/ zhing chen g.yang rked pa 'dra gzhis brgyan pa/ sku smad stag lpags kyi sham thabs mnabs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs kyis bzhengs par bsam/ de'i pang du sbas pa'i yum nag mo tsan+ti ka sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas kyis gri gug /g.yon gyis thod khrag bsnams nas yab la 'khyud pa/ gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dur khrod kyi chas dang rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked par 'khril bar bsgom/ de nas 'khor rnams bskyed pa ni/ dbang bya g.yas la gnad 'bebs g.yon/ ces gsungs pas thugs mgon dregs pa'i mnga' bdag bskyed pa ni/ gtso bo'i g.yas su sbas pa'i mgon po gnod sbyin bya rog gdong can/ sku mdog ljang ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug /g.yon pa yid bzhin gyi nor bus bkang ba gtso bo la stob pa/ g.yas kyi thod pa brten pa/ zhabs g.yas pus mo btsugs pa/ g.yon gyi brang ba btsugs pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ nor bu dang*/ rus pa dang*/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan ba/ gtso bo la 'dud par mdzad pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan 'di rnams nor lha'i rigs la bsgom gsung pa/ gsus khyim che ba// sha rgyas shing rngams la mdzes pa bsgom/ chos 'byung dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi

gi zur (483)gsum du las mgon bya rog gi gdong pa can gsum ni/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyang dur khrod kyi chas dang*/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs dang rus pas brgyan pa gsus khyim che ba/ sha rgyas shing yan lag thung la sbom zhing rags pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis 'dor ba'o// de'i g.yas su sha za seng gdong*/ g.yon du tsan+ti ka gnyis bsgom/ de'i shar du nag po stong*/ lhor sha za 'bum/ nub tu ma mo bye ba/ byang du gnod sbyin khri/ de'i phyi rol du bka'i lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis bskor bar bsam/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar oṃ gyis mtshan pa po/ mgrin pa pad+ma dmar po ra āḥdamar mtshan pa po/ thugs rdo rje sngon po kar hūm̐ sngon mtshan pa po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min dang*/ rdo rje gdan/ dur khrod brgyad/ 'di sde brgyad sprel nas sgrub pa yin/ ḍā ki brgyad bsgom mi dgos gsung*/ bsil ba'i las 'khor lo dkar po/ tshal nas/ ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā las pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dbang bskur/ spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ gzhung las/ sku gsung thugs dang phrin las dang*// yon tan sgrub pa 'di nyid de/ zhes gsungs pa ni gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma lha srin sde brgyad thams cad sku'i byin rlabs nus mthu bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad bsdus nas rang dang gtso 'khor gyi dpral bar oṃ yang 'od 'phros bka'i lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi srog bcu gsung la bsdu/ yang 'od (484)'phros skye 'gro snang srid 'byung ba bzhi'i yon tan dang gzi brjid gsung la bsdu/

yang 'od kyis nyi zla nor bu nags tshal gyi bkrag mdangs gsung la bsdu gsungs la thim/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros gong bzhin sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas āḥl thim/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros pas/ de rnams kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas thugs kar thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten khams kyi mthu nus pa yon tan/ bkrag mdangs gzi brjid srog snying dang*/ yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma zla ba/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad kyi nus pa sibs sib rang dang gtso 'khor rnams la thim par bsam/ yang yon tan sgrub pa 'di nyid/ ces gsungs pa ni gsang gnas kyi gnod sbyin bya rog gdong can ljang ser nor lha ltar sgrub pa/ 'di sku gsung thugs dang sbrel nas sgrub pa yin/ mthu phar byed na chung gis mi tsugs pa yin gsungs/ de yin/ gtso bo'i thugs kar lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng du gnas pa'i srog ni hūm̐ mthing nag /de'i mtha' mar gdags pa'i srog ni/ oṃ badz+ra ka'u wa wa pa sha ya ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces g.yon du 'khor bar bsam/ yum gyi thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar gnas pa'i srog bh+yoḥdamar nag gi mtha' mar gdags pa'i srog ni/ oṃ ki na shwar snying kha rag tsit+ta srog tung tung dun dun breng breng dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐/ g.yas bskor du bsam/ las mgon bzhi'i thugs kar lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i steng du gnas pa'i srog hūm̐ mthing ga re'i mtha' mar las mgon gyi sngags nor bu dmar po'i nang du gab/ ces pa ni/ gdags pa'i srog /oṃ ma hā kā la ka ka mu kha sa ma ya/ srog tung tung dun dun breng breng dzaḥdzaḥ (485)zhes sngags tshan gsum po bzlas pa bya'o// yab yum snyoms 'jug mdzad pa la shes pa rtse gcig tu gtad cing*/

las mgon rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang sngags 'khor gnyis kyi bar na/ gri gug gi so nang du bstan nas 'khor bas gnas pa'i srog rtsa la reg la khad par bsam/ gtso bo yab yum gyi dbu'i steng na bya rog gnag la snum pa mig gsum yod pa gsum gyis g.yas skor ling ling byed par bsam/ yab yum phar gzigs 'di gnas pa'i srog gi tha ma la/ gdags pa'i srog gi mgo thog tu phar 'khor bar bsgom pa yin gsungs/ tshur gzigs mdzad nas snyoms 'jug gi sbyor ba mdzad pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ 'khor rnams kyang bde ba rgyas nas gar byed par bsam/ bdag la bde ba drag po zug rngu dang bcas pa ma skyes kyi bar du bsgom gsungs/ bde ba chen po skyes pa dang*/ gsang gnas kyi gtso bo yab yum gyi sbyor ba 'di gsang ba ltar chags pas dbang du sdud pa yin/ mtshams nas hūm̐ gcig sras kyi tshul du rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas yar byon/ lte lhan skyes ba'i mgon po yab/ rlung bum pa can kha sbyor du bzung*/ skabs su bsnyen pa brgya rtsa re bya gsungs/ thun mong gi khrid dang longs skur sgrub pa'o/ yum la phog pas/ yab yum 'od du zhu nas hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ de snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnas pa'i srog hūm̐ la/ thim/ rang gi snying de tsit+ta rin po che'i gur phub pa lta bu rtse mo gyen la bstan pa'i nang du rtsa sbubs gsum dang ldan pa 'od kyi rang bzhin/ rtsa sbubs dbu ma'i nang du pad nyi ro'i steng du hūm̐ gnas pa'i srog mthing ga /'di la ting nge 'dzin bzhi yod pa'i dang po gnas pa'i srog la shes pa gtad la bsgom// gnyis pa ni/ dbus kyi gnas pa'i srog de yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku (486)mdog sngo skya zar ma'i me tog gsar ba lta bu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa nas yab yum gnyis gsang gnas su bskyed pa ltar bsgom 'di man su thod thod la mi bstan/ /gsum pa ni/

mgon po'i thugs kar bde mchog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa de'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa bsgom/ bzhi pa khyad par 'phags pa'i zab pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ de'i thugs kar dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po/ de'i thugs kar shel gyi mchod rten dkar po bang rim gsum pa bum pa bre bcu gsum 'khor lo char khe btog dang bcas pa 'di 'phro ba sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'dus pa bsgom/ bum pa nang du pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag spus bris pa lta bu/ de'i mtha' mar/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pa sha ya ma hā ka la ye kā li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ rtsa sbubs g.yas kyi nang du hūm̐ mthing nag la gri gug gam/ las mgon bya rog gdong can sku mdog mthing zhes sogs gong ltar bsgom ga /rtsa sbubs g.yon gyi nang du mam̐ smug nag la yum dmar mo rtsa 'jib sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis kyis mda' gzhu dang mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis gar thabs su bzhengs pa'o// de gnyis kyi thugs kar hūm̐ dang mam̐ la snying po gong ltar bskor bar bsam mo// mchod rten gyi gdugs kyi mgo bcu gsum 'khor lo'i thad kar las mgon bya rog gdong can yug po'i 'bru gu gyen la langs pa tsam gsum gyis ling ling bskor bar byed par bsam/ de ltar rtse gcig tu bsgom la bsnyen sngags gsum sbrel la bya/ yang rlung bzung ba (487)dang de gnyis res mos bya gsungs/ de ltar bsgoms pas/ sngar gyi bde ba zug dang bcas pa de lhan gyis zhi nas 'gro/ zhi ba dang yang thugs ka'i gtso bo yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams sku rags mar 'khor lo gnyis mar grags pa yang 'di yin no/ mchan/ nas hūm̐ gcig sras kyi tshul du rtsa dbu ma nas mar byon nas/

gsang gnas kyi gtso bo yab yum la thim pas gtso 'khor rnams gsal gdab la/ yab yum snyoms 'jug byed pa dang 'khor rnams gar byed pa la shes pa gtad/ ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing bde ba skyes pa dang*/ de ltar yar spo mar spo byas pas ting nge 'dzin bde stong gsal zhing goms par gyur pa dang*/ sras tshul hūm̐ de yar rgyug mar rgyug byed cing gtso bo snyoms 'jug byed 'khor gar byed par bsgom/ sras kyi hūm̐ de yar byon nas snying ga'i gtso bo yab yum snyoms 'jug mdzad pa dang*/ 'khor gnyis gar byed pa la shes pa gtad/ ting nge 'dzin gong 'og gsal zhing bde ba skyes pa dang*/ sras kyi hūm̐ de yar rgyug mar rgyug je mgyogs je mgyogs byed pas thugs ka'i gtso 'khor thams cad gar log log byed pa la sems gtad pa gces so// phal cher gsang gnas la gtso cher bya gsungs/ de rnams ni thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag chos skyong zhal nang du gzigs pa'i lugs so// zhal phyir gzigs pa ni nang gi lha rnams mi gsal ba'i tshe mdun bskyed rten gtor la gtso 'khor rnams bskyed la mnyam par bzhag la bzlas pa bya'o// thun 'jog khar gsang gnas kyi 'khor sde brgyad las mgon la thim/ las mgon yum la thim/ yum yab la/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim nas yar byon nas thugs ka'i gtso bo la thim pas/ g.yas g.yon 'khor gnyis gtso bo yab yum la/ yab thugs ka'i lhan skyes la/ (488)de bla ma la/ de mchod rten la/ de hūm̐ nas nā da'i bar du rim gyis thim nas/ dwangs ma'i srog phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /mthar bsngo ba smon lam bya'o de rnams snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la brten nas chos skur sgrub ba'o/ srog dang srog ma yin pa dang*// dwangs ma dang ni snyigs ma las// thun mong khyad par shes par bya/ zhes gsungs te/ srog dang zhes pa ni srog bzhi ma ste/ dwangs ma'i srog ni phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'o// gnas pa'i srog ni mgon po'i sa bon hūm̐ yum gyi sa bon bh+yo mam̐/

btags pa'i srog ni snying po rnams so// 'khrul pa'i srog ni las mgon gyi srog yi ge tri ser po dang bzhi'o// srog ma yin pa ni bla ma'i zhal nas brgyud pa'i man ngag 'di rnams med par/ yi ge gang byung gi sgrub thabs skya sogs sdo sogs mang po bsags nas bsgrubs kyang ye shes mgon po mi 'grub cing dbang du mi 'gro ba'i phyir srog ma yin no// dwangs ma zhes pa ni gsum ste/ lha'i dwangs ma ni/ snying ga dang gsang gnas kyi gtso 'khor rnams so// sngags kyi dwangs ma ni kā li la sogs pa'o// ting nge 'dzin gyi dwangs ma ni/ rlung kha sbyor gcun cing phyag rgya chen po la gnad du bsnun pa'o// snyigs ma zhes pa ni gsum ste/ lha'i snyigs ma ni dgra bsad che 'bring chung gsum dus kyi lha rnams so// sngags kyi snyegs ma ni bzhi snyigs yin/ ting nge 'dzin gyi snyigs ma ni de'i dus su snying rje tshad med pa bsgom pa dang*/ de dus kyi bsad las kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams so// thun mong zhes pa ni gsum ste/ lha ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bde mchog gsang gnas gtso 'khor rnams bsgom pa rnams so// sngags ni de nyid kyi bcu bdun pa rnams sngags sngags tshan gsum pa

ོ so/ ting nge 'dzin ni de rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin skyabs sems sogs sngon 'gro rnams so no/ khyad par zhes pa ni/ (489)lha'i rnal 'byor ni snying ga'i gtso 'khor rnams/ sngags kyi khyad par ni kā li btags pa'o// ting nge 'dzin thugs ka'i rim pa bzhi ldan du bsgom pa'o// de yan chad chags pas dbang du sdud pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum la brten nas/ stod las byang chub lam du 'khyer ba'i rim pa rnams so// ༈ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// nag po chen po'i man ngag gi ma de la thung la gnyis te/ nor sgrub pa dang*/ dbang du sdud pa gnyis so// dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sku rags kyi mngon rtogs lta bur bsgoms la bsnyen pa sum sbrel bya/ khyad par du gsang gnas kyi phyag bzhi pa'i phyag g.yas kyi dang po'i phyag mtshan bai 'bras de yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal por bsgom/ de'i thugs ka dang phyag mtshan gnyis ka las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ mnyes nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad tshur bsdus/ 'jig rten khams kyi lha 'dre mi gsum dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi dang*/ sman dang rtsi bcud/ bkrag gzi mdangs/ yon tan nus mthu/ tshe dpal grags pa dbang phyug dang*/ nyi zla gnyis kyi yar ngo thams cad dbang du bsdus/ 'jig rten khams kyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ rin po che sna bdun/ zas nor thams cad dbang du bsdus nas/ rlung gcig tshur rngubs pa dang*/ rlung dang 'grogs nas rang gi zhal du zhugs nas/ rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis la brgyud nas gsang gnas kyi phyag bzhi pa'i phyag g.yas gyi phyag mtshan la sibs sib thim/ yab yum gnyis la yang thim pas/ (490)sngar bas byin rlabs gzi mdangs rgyas/

sku lus thams cad la yang yid bzhin nor bu dpag tu med pas brgyan pa/ thugs ka dang phyag mtshan gnyis ka las 'od zer dpag med 'phros pas/ rang gi gnas khang bang mdzod thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'bru dang*/ gos dang*/ zas nor sna tshogs gang 'dod kyis gang bar bsgom/ las mgon rnams kyang de ltar ro// gnyis pa dbang sdud ni/ phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po shing thog baita rlon pa dmar po mdangs dang ldan par bsgom/ de la thugs ka dang phyag mtshan gnyis gnas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ rang gi rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis nas yar brgyud nas sna bug gnyis nas 'phros/ sna bug g.yas nas rlung rgyu na yab dang*/ g.yon rgyu yin 'dug na yum gyi thugs dang phyag mtshan las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang du bsdu gang 'dod kyi bla ma dang*/ rgyal po'i spyi bor phog /gzhan pho rigs thams cad kyi snying ga /bud med thams cad kyi bha ga'i nang du phog pas/ 'dar phri li li gyur nas rang dbang med par mdun du bkug nas phyi rgan du yod par bsgom/ de'i snying ga'i sa bon yi ge n-i zhig yod pa de 'od zer gyis tshur bsdus nas rlung rngubs pa dang lhan cig tu rang gi sna bug tu zhugs/ rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis la brgyud nas mgon po yab yum gyi phyag mtshan dang*/ pho'i sa bon yab kyi thugs ka dang*/ mo'i sa mo yin na yum gyi thugs ka dang yab kyi gsang gnas su'o/ mchan/ bon yum gyi bha gar thim pas sngar bas bkrag mdangs gzi mdangs che bar bsgom/ yang bai 'bras las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas rang gi bshang lam nas thon/ pho mo gang 'gugs kyi lus la reg pa tsam gyis lus de 'ub kyis/ bsdus nas/ rang gi bshang lam nas tshur zhugs (491)nas mgon po yab yum gyi zhabs 'og tu hril gyis tshud nas dbang du 'dus par bsgom/ 'di zab don khyad par 'phags pa'i gnad yin gsungs/ gzhan la phyag mtshan las 'od zer spros nas/

dbang du sdud pa tsam las ma bstan pa yin gsungs/ dbang sdud dang nor sgrub 'di gnyis dmigs pa bzung res bya zhing rlung bzung ba dang*/ bzlas pa bya ba gnyis res mos byed pa la bar bar du dwangs ma'i srog phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag gsungs/ bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pa sha ya ma hā kā lā ya kā li pa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'am/ gong gi sku rags lta bur yab yum gnyis las mgon dang gsum sbrel bya la bzlas so// man ngag mdel thung*/ ༈ dpal mgon nag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ de nas gzhung las/ drag pos las la sbyar zhes pa la/ smad phrin las lam du khyer ba'i man ngag la gsum ste/ dgra bsad che chung 'bring gsum mo/ de la dang po che ba la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la 'dir ting nge 'dzin snyigs ma sogs gzhung du rgyas par yod/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes su bsgoms pa de zhu ba las/ dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas kyi khang pa phyi gru bzhi/ de'i nang du thod pa'i gzhal yas khang gru gsum pa 'jigs su rung ba de'i nang du khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po keng rus dang zhing chen gyi lhu rdum dang*/ zhag dang ro'i ling log mang du byed par bsam/ de'i dbus su yar drag po'i chu skyes sngo nag zur gsum pa'i sdong bu gcig bsam/ de'i steng du gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bsam/ de'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang zhing chen bsnol ba'i steng du sa bon la mi ltos par skad cig dran rdzogs su bsgom gsungs/ rang nyid dpal ye shes mgon po gsang gnas (492)kyi skabs na bsgom pa ltar bskyed/ khyad par du khro ba gtum pa drag cing cher khros pa'i gzugs can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug /gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba'i yab yum bskyed do// gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la la tri ser po brgyad las bka' sdod bya rog gdong can brgyad/ de rnams kyang khro gtum rngams pa'i tshul du bsgom/

thugs kar tri re re bsgom/ de'i phyi rol du bka'i lha ma srin sde brgyad dang po rgyud dang mo rgyud kyi 'khor tshogs rnams bsam/ gtso bo'i sku gsung thugs gong ltar byin gyi brlab/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brgya rtsas brtan par bya/ gtso bo yab yum thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang mam̐/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar tri la gzhi snying gcig dril gyis bskor bar bsam/ sngags ni sngags 'bum na yon/ oṃ ma hā kā la nri thun lang thun ril rbad ces pa la sogs pa yin no// rang gi rlung g.yas nas rgyu na yab gyi thugs ka dang*/ g.yon nas rgyu na yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'khor las mgon brgyad kyi thugs kar phog /de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i pho nya las mkhan lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu tho ba bsnams pa/ pho nya glog ltar 'khyug cing yang rtsal thog ltar drag pa mang po spros nas/ lcags kyu can gyis snying nas phug /zhags pa can gyis rke nas thogs/ lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag bcings/ dril bu can gyis lus sems myos/ dgra bgegs gang na 'dug kyang las ngan rlung gi dkyil 'khor la lus bskyon nas rang dbang med par/ rang dang las mgon brgyad kyi bar du bkug nas byung bar bsam/ gan rkyal du rang gi mdun du yod par bsam/ mthu chung zhing las 'gyangs na bdag gi (493)thugs ka nas gri gug re 'phros/ 'khor brgyad po'i thugs kar song nas tri ser po la so gtad nas 'khor bar bsam mo/ sngags ni gzhi snying bzla ba yin no// rang gi gnas gsum nas sngags 'bru gsum gyis bkrag sdud byed pa la sogs pa yin no 'od zer 'phros pas/ dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi bkrag dang gzi mdangs mthu nus pa yon tan kha rje bsod nams dbang thang la sogs 'ub kyis bsdus nas rang la thim pas/ rang nyid bkrag gzi mdangs bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam/

kho'i lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang*/ bsgrubs shing bsnyen pa'i lha srung rnams kyang 'ub kyis bsdus nas rang la thim pas/ kho skyabs mgon dang bral nas 'dar yed yed sngangs bred bred byed par bsam/ gong ltar rlung brtags la/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas las mgon rnams la phog /de rnams khros shing 'khrugs nas/ las mgon rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'od zer rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gri gug gnyis su gyur te/ de gnyis dgra bo'i kha dang bshang lam gnyis su zhugs nas gcig de spyi bo nas g.yas su/ gcig de bshang lam nas g.yon du sga ra ra bskor bas/ spyi bo man dang bshang lam yan gyi sha rus rnams bcad nas snying gar 'khor bas snying tshal pa la lings kyis bkas nas/ snying nang gi sa bon nṛ ljang gu dang*/ de'i nang nas bder gshegs snying po'i ngo bo a dkar po gnyis spyi bo tshangs bug nas thon nas/ rang nyid phyag bzhi pa yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas zhugs/ rtsa dbu ma brgyud de spyi bo mi bskyod pa'i rigs bdag gi thugs kar zhing du bzhag la/ dmigs med du bzhag go /gnas spar ba'o// rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ las mgon rnams bskul nas/ dgra bo'i gzugs po de rang nyid yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams (494)su bskyur bas yum gyi bha ga de brub khung du bsam/ yab kyi rdo rje de phur pa'i dpal rno ba'i ngar ldan du bsam la/ sbyor ba byas pas dgra bo'i lus sha rus thams cad dum bur thor thor song ba rnams las mgon brgyad pos zos par bsam/ de ni dgra bo'i lus tshogs su 'bul ba yin no// gnyis pa dgra bsad 'bring ba ni/ dur khrod kyi pho brang gong ltar bskyed la/ gsang gnas su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa'i dbus su mgon po yab yum gong ltar bsgom/ zur gsum la tri ser po gsum las las mgon bya rog gdong can gsum bskyed/

des rgyab tu sha za dang*/ g.yon du thugs mgon dregs pa'i mnga' bdag gnyis bsgom na legs gsungs so// de gnod sbyin bya rog gdong la zer/ de rnams la ye shes pa bstim/ thugs kar tri ser po la gzhi snying gis bskor ba dmigs pa gzhi snying gi bzlas pa bya/ dgra bo dgug sgrol sogs gong ltar bya'o// gri gug spro dus las mgon gyi phyag gi gri gug las spro'o// / 'di la mkho ba'i bder gshegs phag grus mdzad pa'i sngags 'bum dang*/ srog bzhi ma yang gnad che/ man ngag sprel lo/ ༈ gsum pa dgra bsad chung ba ni/ lha sgom pa dang*/ dgra bo dgug pa dgra bsad chung ba zhal la dris/ la sogs dgra bsad 'bring po dang mtshungs/ khyad par du dgra bo de lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang bral zhing*/ skyabs med par lus 'dar bzhin pa'i tshul du yod pa'i snying nang na khrag gi rlangs pa byi'u lan ma'i mgo tsam zhig yod pa de/ skad cig gis gnam lcags kyi sdig pa nag la rtsub pa/ 'jigs la rngams pa/ khro la gtum pa gcig tu gyur nas/ snying nang gi rtsa dang srog rtsa khrag la sogs pa zos/ don snying glo mchin nang khrol thams cad ma lus par zos/ phyi'i lus po khog pa (495)yang lhag ma med par thos te rdul tsam yang med par byas/ mthar sdig pa chos nyid du thim par bsam/ gnad thams cad bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o// dgra bsad chung ba 'di yi ge'i ris med na yang*/ gsol ba btab pas bla mas gnang pa byin te bka' mi nub pa'i don du/ snyan brgyud yi ger bkod pa'o// gzhan bka' lung ma thob pa la ma ston cig /'bul ba gser srang re ma phul na mi ston pa'i bka' rgya yod// / ༈ sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ dgra bo rang gi gsang gnas gru gsum/ bsil ba'i tshal du ljon shing gsum gyi rtsa ba na dang po bkug la/ 'khrul 'khor gsum gyis rtsa gsum nang rlung gtum mo bsil ba'i tshal du me sbar la/ me nang gi lha rnams kyi zhal du bsgrub bya'i sha khrag bsregs nas gsol bas mnyes shing tshims par bsam/

de nas mnan pa bya ba ni/ sum mdor k+ṣa yig nag po zur gsum pa'i nang du dgra bo bkug la rkang pa skyil krung gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram yod pas kha bcad/ de'i steng du lto ba zlum po chu'i dkyil 'khor gyis mnan/ de'i steng sgal tshig ri rab lhun pos mnan/ de steng chos skyong gis pho brang btab par bsam/ don dbu ma'i nang yin no// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sgrol byed chen po/ phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze sa ra ha pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dus zhabs che ba/ dus zhabs chung ba/ rdo rje gdan pa/ a bhā ya ka ra/ tsa mi lo tsā/ de gnyis ka la dpal rgwa los zhus/ de nas bde gshegs phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po/ sangs rgyas dbon rin po che/ rgyal ba gcung rin po che/ rgyal sras thog kha ba/ spyan snga mtshams bcad pa/ chos rje nub pa/ chos rje bcu gnyis pa/ nyer brgyad pa rdo rje rgyal po/ nyer (496)gnyis pa chos kyi rgyal po/ drung a po pa/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang ba/ rje btsun ye shes dbang phyug /rje btsun rin po che dzñā na ke tu/ bla ma kun dga' seṅge/ yang na klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ klu'i byang chub/ rdo rje gdan pa/ a bhā ya ka ra/ tsa mi/ dpal sga lo/ bde gshegs phag gru/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po/ spyan snga rin po che grags pa 'byung gnas/ rgyal ba grags pa brtson 'grus/ grub thob wo la pa/ brag pa rin chen rgyal ba/ rgyud bla rdo rje rin chen/ bla ma mgon gzhon pa/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dpon po rgyal mchog /bdag po grags blo/ grub thob ngag gi dbang po/ rin chen bkra shis pa/ des kun seng pa la'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
